summary: Monitors connected WebSocket clients and channel subscription topology from the Standalone HttpFileServer broker.

ports.name: Server Instance
ports.text: The Server Instance object from Ops.Local.Standalone.HttpFileServer.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable live client monitoring.

ports.name: On Client Connected
ports.text: Fires when a new WebSocket client connects to the server.

ports.name: On Client Disconnected
ports.text: Fires when a WebSocket client disconnects from the server.

ports.name: Active Client Count
ports.text: Total number of currently connected WebSocket clients.

ports.name: Client List
ports.text: Array of connected client metadata objects ({ id, ip, connectedAt, subscriptions }).

ports.name: Last Client ID
ports.text: ID of the most recently connected or disconnected client.

ports.name: Active Channels
ports.text: Array of all channel names that currently have active subscribers.
